closureNote: Recorded domain viaboffe.com.au does not resolve (NXDOMAIN, checked 2026-09-13 against 1.1.1.1). A business named Via Boffe does trade, but as a cafe at 59 Main Street, Mornington (https://via-boffe.square.site/ and https://www.agfg.com.au/restaurant/via-boffe-130095), not as the Main Ridge trattoria described here. Because both the locality and the format differ, the Mornington cafe has deliberately not been recorded as this record's corrected URL. Whether the Main Ridge room described here closed, moved, or was never separate cannot be told from public sources. Unresolved.

retiredSourceLinks.note: Domain does not resolve.
